presets.description:
New to Final Fantasy IV, or just new to Free Enterprise? Here's a good place to start.

Find great loot, hunt down the Crystal, and take on Zeromus! Check out the Newbie Guide for help.

presets.name: Learning the Randomizer
presets.flags: O1:quest_forge/req:all/win:crystal Kmain Pkey Cstandard/abilities:j Twildish Sstandard Bstandard/whichburn Etoggle Hrandom Gwarp/life/sylph/backrow Fweighted Aagnostic Zvanilla -kit:better -spoon -vanilla:zot
presets.description: For players who are a little more familiar with Final Fantasy IV. Find the Legend Sword and Adamant Rock, and have Kokkol forge the Excalibur to earn your Crystal.

presets.name: Intermediate
presets.flags: Orandom:5,quest/req:4/win:crystal Kmain/summon/moon Pkey Cstandard/abilities:j Twildish Sstandard Bstandard/whichburn Etoggle Hrandom Gwarp/life/sylph/backrow Fweighted Aagnostic Zvanilla -kit:better -spoon -vanilla:zot
presets.description: Once you're familiar with the basics, it's time to start questing! Now the Lunar Subterrane and Summon bosses can hold your key items too. Complete four out of five random quests to earn the Crystal.

presets.name: Next Steps
presets.flags: O1:quest_forge/random:5,tough_quest/req:5/win:crystal Kmain/summon/moon/nofree Pkey Cstandard/nofree/abilities:j/nodupes Tpro Sstandard Bstandard/whichburn Etoggle Hrandom Glife/sylph/backrow Fweighted Aagnostic Zvanilla -kit:better -noadamants -spoon -vanilla:zot
presets.description:
Now's a good time to check out the other preset categories to start exploring the wide variety of flagsets available in FF4FE.

If you want a more advanced version of the above flagsets, here's a typical tournament-style flagset.

presets.name: Casual
presets.flags: Onone Kmain/force:magma Pshop Crelaxed Twild Swild Bstandard/whyburn Etoggle Hrandom Gdupe/mp/warp/life/sylph/backrow/64 Fvanilla Aagnostic Zvanilla -spoon -vanilla:zot
presets.description: Relaxed flags for a breezy/introductory playthrough of Free Enterprise.

presets.name: Intermediate
presets.flags: Onone Kmain Pshop Cstandard/abilities:j Twild Sstandard Bstandard/whyburn Etoggle Hrandom Gdupe/mp/warp/life/sylph Fweighted Aagnostic Zvanilla -spoon -vanilla:zot
presets.description: For players with a few seeds under their belt, these flags move past the Casual preset by emphasizing treasure hunting and introducing some core FE concepts seen in common Free Enterprise play.

presets.name: Advanced
presets.flags: Onone Kmain/summon/moon/nofree Pkey Cstandard/nofree/maybe/abilities:j Tstandard Sstandard Bstandard Etoggle Hrandom Glife/sylph Fweighted Avanilla Zvanilla -vanilla:zot
presets.description: Flags for players interested in exploring competitive FE play.

presets.name: Ladder Standard
presets.flags: Orandom:7,tough_quest/req:6/win:crystal Kmain/summon/moon Pkey Cstandard/nofree/j:abilities/nekkie Twildish Sstandard Bstandard/alt:gauntlet Etoggle Hrandom Gwarp/life/sylph/backrow Fweighted Aagnostic Zvanilla -kit:better -noadamants -spoon -vanilla:zot
presets.description: A standard competitive FE flagset, updated from the previous season's standard increasing the objective count and guaranteeing that every character appears at least once.

presets.name: Ladder Hard
presets.flags: O1:quest_forge/random:6,tough_quest/req:6/win:crystal Kmain/summon/moon/nofree Pkey Cstandard/nofree/distinct:9/start:any/no:fusoya/j:abilities Tpro Sstandard Bstandard/alt:gauntlet Etoggle Hrandom Glife/sylph/backrow Fweighted Aagnostic Zvanilla -kit:basic -noadamants -spoon -smith:alt -vanilla:zot
presets.description: A more difficult version of Ladder Standard where pro loot means you must invest more time to get more power. FuSoYa wants to be the star of the show, and will not accept any other role, which means if you don't see Fu as your starting character, he will not make an appearance. Without the wildish loot, the weight of Cmaybe can prove exceptionally challenging when an army of Tellahs and Edwards seek to join your party. Don't forget about D.Mist gating a key item! Good luck!

presets.name: Supermarket Sweep
presets.flags: Orandom:4,tough_quest,boss/req:3/win:crystal Kmain Pshop Crelaxed/j:abilities Twild Swild/free/no:apples Bstandard/whyburn Etoggle Hrandom Glife/sylph Fweighted Aagnostic Zvanilla -spoon -vanilla:zot
presets.description: The strongest equipment, items, and characters may be available right out the gate. Shops are free!

presets.name: Fu in Wario Land
presets.flags: O1:quest_forge/2:quest_tradepink/3:quest_pass/win:crystal Kmain/miab/nofree Pkey Crelaxed/nofree/start:fusoya/j:abilities Twildish Sstandard/no:j Bstandard/nofree/alt:gauntlet Etoggle/noexp Hrandom Gwarp/life/sylph/backrow Fvanilla Aagnostic Zvanilla -kit:freedom -vanilla:zot,fusoya
presets.description: Where does Fu go when he's banned from tournament play? Treasure hunting! He wants only the finest weapons, armor, and secret pathways home. However, the price you pay for this immense power is Bnofree, and no ability to grind random encounters, so be wary!

presets.name: Omnidextrous
presets.flags: O2:quest_monsterking/4:quest_whitealtar/random:5,tough_quest/req:6/win:crystal Kmain/summon/moon/nofree Pkey Crelaxed/nofree/distinct:5/j:abilities/nekkie/nodupes Twild/sparse:80/maxtier:7 Spro Bstandard/alt:gauntlet Etoggle Hrandom Glife/sylph/backrow Fweighted Aagnostic Zvanilla -kit:basic -spoon -vanilla:zot -wacky:omnidextrous
presets.description: Utilizing the Omnidextrous flag, any character can equip any weapon or piece of armor, and treasures are bumped up to accommodate. Characters, however, are at a premium, and shops are reduced a bit so make those treasures count!

presets.name: Lali-Ho Redux

presets.description: Think Lali-Ho Swiss, but a little more generous for the beginner-to-intermediate race. Crelaxed and full sell prices ease things a bit. That being said, Giott is giving you his personal armor instead of letting you break the economy with jewelry. Oh, and it's quest objectives instead of boss/character hunts, just to mix things up.

presets.name: Fabul Gauntlet Mark II

presets.description: The flagset from our 2020 spring event returns with a new twist: the objectives will always be tough quests. Complete all 5 to get the Crystal and defeat Zeromus. Don't forget about D.Mist!

presets.name: Finders Keepers

presets.description: The big nasty of Season 3. Shops give Cabins. Treasure is set to Tpro. Permajoin and Cbye are both on. Your one breather is the Warp glitch, but how long do you wait for a black mage to show up?

presets.name: 10/10 Would Race Again

Gather as much strength as you can to be safe, or dive as soon as possible and hope for a couple easy bosses. The game ends when you launch the Falcon with the guaranteed overworld Hook.

Be smart with your purchases, your goal is to complete a Lunar run to finish the seed. Push B to Jump is enabled to open up the world as much as possible to allow you to get that Darkness Crystal as soon as you can, then sprint... (through space) to the moon!

presets.name: MacGiant %
presets.description: The Highway to the Zemus Zone VI flagset encouraged players to learn and master the MacGiant grind, mostly by making all the better options untenable. Leaning into that a little bit more, MacGiant% makes the Giant of Bab-il (where a MacGiant grind is performed) a hard required objective - meaning you have to complete it to get the crystal regardless of which other objectives you complete. To make things coast a little more consistently, I've bumped up the quality of the starting gear (Cthrift:4 instead of Cnekkie), given you a single Cursed Ring and some exp scaling, and make the flagset require 5 of the 8 non-Giant objectives.
